canonical_data: Local conversation logs and a Markdown memory store shared across agent harnesses, plus git-tracked workspace files for scaffolded persistent agents
current_repo_note: Covers the gptme agent, its server and web UI, desktop shell, and ACP package in this repository. The managed gptme.ai cloud service the README lists as in progress, the community gptme-contrib plugins, and the reference autonomous agents it links are separate and not reviewed here. The cross-harness memory store is one feature of the agent and does not make this a memory product.
strengths: A very large tool surface in source form, with shell, patching, browser, computer-use, sub-agent, tmux, MCP, and memory tools, plus per-call confirmation, a circuit breaker, checkpoints, and a sandbox module
Works both as an MCP client and an MCP server and as an ACP coding agent inside Zed and JetBrains, so other tools can embed it
One of the longest-running agent CLIs, with a large test tree, a published evaluation suite, and plain-file memory, lessons, and configuration a person can edit
weaknesses: Breadth is the cost: the same package spans a terminal agent, a server, a web UI, a desktop shell, scheduled-agent scaffolding, and an eval harness, so the boundary of what is maintained to the same standard is wide
The persistent autonomous-agent and multi-agent coordination story is mostly scaffolding and reference agents hosted in other repositories, which this review did not read
Pre-1.0 versioning at 0.34.0 after three years signals that interfaces still change
why_it_matters: An early, still-active, provider-agnostic terminal agent whose local-first design and plain-file memory make it a transparent alternative to the vendor-owned coding CLIs.
